narration: Hello, everyone! Welcome to a magical little celebration! Today, I have a very special little princess to introduce to you! She's adorable, sweet, and surrounded by so much love. Come on, let's get to know her!

Everyone, meet the lovely little princess, Zaelah Hesztia Tembreza Delos Santos! She's about to turn ONE! Isn't that exciting? And guess what? She's also going to celebrate her very special Baptism! Mommy and Daddy are preparing a beautiful celebration to make this day unforgettable!

Now, let's mark our calendars! This magical celebration will happen on December second, twenty twenty-six, at three o'clock in the afternoon! And where will all the fun and magic happen? At Cai's Garden Resort! So, don't forget the date!

With her sweetest smile, tiny little hands, and a heart surrounded by endless love, Zaelah is growing up to be such a precious little girl! Her first birthday is a beautiful milestone, and everyone is excited to celebrate this wonderful moment with her!

But wait, there's something even more special! Along with her first birthday, Zaelah will also receive the beautiful Sacrament of Holy Baptism! It's the beginning of her journey of faith, filled with God's endless love, grace, and blessings. What a wonderful gift!

Mommy and Daddy warmly invite everyone to be part of this beautiful celebration! Your presence will surely make Zaelah's special day even more memorable. And here's a little reminder about what to wear! Guests are kindly requested to wear semi-formal or casual attire in the lovely pastel colors. Let's make this celebration extra pretty!

And that's the magical story of our little princess, Zaelah! Her first birthday and Baptism wouldn't be complete without all the wonderful people who love her. So, come and celebrate, share your sweetest smiles, and create beautiful memories together! We can't wait to see you there! See you soon! Bye-bye, everyone!
